mechanisms.name: 淀粉颗粒羟基吸附与改性增强
mechanisms.name_en: Hydroxyl adsorption and modification-enhanced adsorption of starch granules
mechanisms.description: 淀粉颗粒的-OH通过氢键和络合作用吸附污染物，改性后引入-COOH/-NH₂可显著增强重金属吸附容量。
mechanisms.description_en: The -OH groups of starch granules adsorb pollutants through hydrogen bonding and complexation. Modification introduces -COOH/-NH2 groups, which can significantly enhance the adsorption capacity for heavy metals.

causal_chain.transferable_principle: 淀粉颗粒-OH通过氢键/络合吸附，改性（接枝、交联、酯化）引入新官能团可大幅增强吸附容量
causal_chain.transferable_principle_en: The -OH groups of starch granules adsorb via hydrogen bonding/complexation. Modification (grafting, crosslinking, esterification) introduces new functional groups that can greatly enhance adsorption capacity.

pollutant_feature.text: 重金属阳离子、染料、有机污染物
pollutant_feature.quote: 生素、有机污染物、悬浮物、激素、生物污染物）的处理
pollutant_feature.scope_match: Keywords: 有机污染物, 有机污染

bio_structure.text: 淀粉颗粒的半结晶结构（直链+支链淀粉），表面含丰富-OH

interaction.text: 氢键、络合配位（改性后）、静电吸引（带电改性）、范德华力
interaction.quote: 范德华力是一种通用的吸附机
interaction.scope_match: Keywords: 范德, 范德华, 范德华力, 德华, 德华力

why_it_works.text: 天然来源丰富、成本低、可生物降解，-OH可进一步改性增强功能
why_it_works.quote: 种低成本的替代方法[4]，其处理效率高、成本低，优势

boundary_conditions.text: 天然淀粉吸附容量较低，需化学改性（接枝/交联/酯化）才能达到实用水平
淀粉基吸附剂在强酸/强碱条件下可能水解，需控制pH范围
验证数据覆盖pH 4-7范围，pH<4或>7的吸附行为未经验证

causal_chain.verification_quote: The standard causal links of sorption onto MSAs involve electrostatic attraction, π-π stacking interplay, π-cations interplay, intraparticle dispersion, van der Waals interplay, H-bonding, bulk, and simple diffusion, physical adsorption, and chemical adsorption

engineering_constraints.constraint: 天然淀粉吸附容量低，必须化学改性（接枝/交联/酯化）才能达到实用水平
engineering_constraints.explanation: 未改性淀粉的羟基密度和孔隙结构不足以提供工程级吸附容量

engineering_constraints.constraint: 不适用于强酸/强碱环境，淀粉糖苷键水解导致结构破坏
engineering_constraints.explanation: pH<2或pH>12时淀粉主链水解，颗粒结构丧失

engineering_constraints.constraint: 不适用于高温糊化环境(>65°C)，淀粉颗粒糊化失去多孔结构
engineering_constraints.explanation: 淀粉在65°C以上发生糊化，颗粒结构破坏，吸附位点丧失

engineering_constraints.constraint: 微生物降解限制再生次数和使用寿命
engineering_constraints.explanation: 淀粉是生物可降解高分子，环境中微生物可水解利用

design_translation.idea: 利用淀粉颗粒的羟基和改性后的羧基/氨基进行重金属吸附
design_translation.material_handle: 改性淀粉微球、淀粉基水凝胶、淀粉生物炭
design_translation.target_interaction: 螯合配位、静电吸引、离子交换
design_translation.design_principle: 淀粉颗粒-OH通过氢键和络合吸附污染物，改性(接枝丙烯酸、交联、酯化)引入-COOH/-NH₂可显著增强吸附容量
design_translation.implementation_example: 淀粉+丙烯酸(APS引发)→接枝共聚→淀粉-g-PAA凝胶 → 金属吸附；或淀粉+环糊精包合→有机污染物吸附
design_translation.constraints: 天然淀粉容量低需改性；强酸/碱水解；微生物降解
design_translation.failure_modes: 改性不均匀；酸碱水解；生物降解限制再生次数
design_translation.evidence_tier: lead (有61行性能数据但缺 verification_quote)
